fusions.name: Peel a Layer
fusions.desc: Hooks the shield's rim under the target's plates, which deals 4 damage and strips 6% of its armour for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Breastplate Toll
fusions.desc: Slams the shield against your own breastplate. The ring deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stuns them for 1 second.

fusions.name: Plate on Plate
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 26 damage and holds for 8 seconds, and your armour rises by 10% while it holds.

fusions.name: Lamellar Coat
fusions.desc: Conjures a harness of plates behind the shield: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 12%, and 5% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it. The harness adds a further 5% armour.
